**Visual analysis of test image:**
- Field view of soybean plants
- One plant in the center has tan/dried, desiccated pods and stems
- Surrounding plants remain green and healthy-looking
- The affected plant shows premature drying of pods/stems — a "dead plant among green" pattern

**Comparison with Diaporthe reference:**
- The top-left panel of the Diaporthe collage is nearly identical to the test image — a single plant with dried pods and stems surrounded by green foliage
- Diaporthe (stem canker / pod and stem blight) causes exactly this: premature wilting and drying of pods and stems while neighboring plants remain healthy
- The tan/bleached dried pod appearance matches Diaporthe pod blight
